children: As a thank-you to its Canadian fans, Jollibee will kick off its fun-filled anniversary campaign on Sept. 7, offering special Rewards offers, limited-time deals and exclusive merch – with more surprises to be revealed in the coming weeks.

TORONTO, Sept. 4, 2026 /CNW/ -- Global restaurant sensation Jollibee, beloved for its mouth-watering Jolly Crispy Chicken fried chicken, juicy Chicken Sandwiches and iconic Peach Mango Pie, will soon reach an exciting milestone: 10 years of spreading joy across Canada. To thank fans for their loyal support throughout its joyful Canadian journey, Jollibee is launching its 10-Week "Jolly Deals" Countdown starting Monday, Sept. 7. Running through the end of the year, this national campaign delivers weekly surprises—from limited-time offers and bonus Rewards points to exclusive merchandise, a nationwide sweepstakes, and community giving.

Jollibee made its Canada debut with the opening of its first store in Winnipeg, Manitoba in December 2016. Over the last ten years, Jollibee has grown from a single location into a 28-restaurant network across five provinces, where the brand has introduced its signature menu and joyful hospitality to delight new communities while serving as a familiar favourite for longtime guests. For some Canadians, Jollibee is a comforting taste of home; for others, it is a destination for discovering the brand's signature take on fried chicken. That combination of emotional connection and broad appeal has helped drive Jollibee's growth in Canada, with the brand gaining legions of fans every time it opens its doors in a new city.

Kicking off on Sept. 7, the "Jolly Deals" Countdown is a fun, celebratory series that offers Jollibee fans a different way to celebrate each week, from extra savings and extra Jollibee Rewards points to limited-run anniversary merch and a prize-packed sweepstakes. The lineup will also include a delicious way for fried chicken lovers to satisfy their cravings while supporting their local community.
10 … 9 … 8 … 7: Announcing the First Four Jolly Deals

The first four Jolly Deals in the 10-week lineup feature a curated mix of Jollibee Rewards offers and celebratory experiences– all designed to thank our fans for the support that has made Jollibee Canada such a success.
– Jollibee will launch the countdown with a craveable value offer for both new and existing Rewards members: spend $30 and receive $10 off their next Jollibee order.
Jollibee will invite fans to share the joy through fun simple challenges. Select customers who show off their joy will be rewarded with free meals—because spreading joy deserves a delicious reward.
– Jollibee will treat Rewards members to an exclusive in-store promo: a limited-edition mascot glass tumbler, which will be available for just $25 with any eligible dine-in or takeout purchase.
– Fans can celebrate Thanksgiving with Jollibee Catering and receive a $25 coupon toward their next catering order when they place an order of $300 or more.
Additionally, throughout September, Jollibee will offer two "
– a 2-piece Jolly Crispy Chicken Meal for $10 and a 10-piece Jolly Crispy Chicken Bucket for $35 – as a special thank-you to fans who have been a part of its Canadian journey since day one.

Jollibee will announce Jolly Deals 6 through 1 in mid-October. Without giving too much away just yet, there will be some marquee anniversary moments fans won't want to miss, including a chicken-bucket themed fundraiser benefiting Make-A-Wish® Canada, a nationwide Rewards sweepstakes, an exclusive anniversary merch drop, and much more!

"Celebrating 10 years in Canada is an incredible and humbling milestone for our brand," said Beth Dela Cruz, President, Jollibee North America. "Since opening our doors in Winnipeg in 2016, Canadians from coast to coast have welcomed Jollibee into their communities and made us a part of their family traditions. Our Jolly Deals Countdown is our way of showing our gratitude to our passionate fans, with extra value and joyful surprises for the guests who have been part of our journey over the past decade."
Building Momentum in the Next Decade … and Beyond

The 10th anniversary celebration comes as Jollibee continues to build momentum in Canada and around the world. As a testament to its broadening consumer appeal, Jollibee was recently named to the 2026 TIME100 Most Influential Companies list and was ranked among the Top 10 Industry Leaders in Food & Drink on TIME Magazine's inaugural short list.

The strong reception Jollibee has received from Canadian guests over the past decade, together with the experience it has gained operating in the market, is shaping the brand's next phase of growth. Jollibee plans to expand its Canadian footprint through franchise partnerships, with multi-unit franchise development agreements across British Columbia and Alberta representing a committed pipeline of 26 additional restaurants. This expansion will bring the brand's Jolly Crispy Chicken, Chicken Sandwiches, Peach Mango Pie and Jolly Spaghetti to more Canadian neighbourhoods.

To stay connected to the "Jolly Deals" Countdown, be sure to follow @jollibeecanada on TikTok, @jollibeecanada on Instagram, and @jollibeecan on Facebook to learn more about each week's featured offering. Fans can also download the Jollibee Canada App and sign up for Jollibee Canada Rewards. For more information about Jollibee's 10th Anniversary celebration, visit http://ca.jollibeefoods.com/canada10th.
